title: crocus albiflorus subsp. neapolitanus
intro: Crocus albiflorus subsp. neapolitanus, commonly known as the White Naples Crocus, is a plant species within the genus Crocus, characterized by its white or pale purple flowers. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Crocus albiflorus subsp. neapolitanus include its ability to alleviate pain, reduce inflammation, and exhibit sedative effects, making it a potential natural remedy for anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, such as crocin and safranal, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are also used as natural food colorings and flavorings.
